narr: Afternoon thunderstorms developed along the Continental Divide and then moved east into the Rio Grande Valley. A strong and slow moving storm caused considerable flash flooding across Albuquerque.
ev: The right two lanes of I-25 southbound near Avenida Caesar Chavez were flooded under two feet of water due to heavy rainfall. One vehicle was partially submerged and at least one other vehicle was stalled out. Traffic was backed up nearly nine miles to Paseo del Norte Boulevard.

A video shared on social media by the local media showed that heavy rain caused a waterfall over a hillside below the Petroglyph National Monument. A cul-de-sac near Taylor Ranch was also inundated with hail and heavy rainfall.
